card.name: Right before opioid drug names
card.fires_on: The word or letter just before an opioid or opioid-combination drug name, such as the N of naloxone after buprenorphine and, or 'with' before buprenorphine. It appears in opioid treatment and switching sections of labels.

modes.label: Start of naloxone
modes.description: The first letter of naloxone after 'and' in a buprenorphine or pentazocine combination name.

modes.label: Linking word before opioid
modes.description: A small word like 'with', 'to' or 'when beginning' that comes right before an opioid drug name.
